info.title: Postlater
info.description:
A self-hosted message server that speaks the QStash API. Point `@upstash/qstash`, `@upstash/workflow`, or any app built on them, at it by setting `QSTASH_URL`, `QSTASH_TOKEN` and the two signing keys.

Every `/v2` request needs `Authorization: Bearer <QSTASH_TOKEN>`. Errors are JSON: `{"error": "…"}`.

201.description: The message, or one per endpoint of a URL group.

oneOf.description: For a URL group: one message per endpoint.

post.description:
Headers that start with `Upstash-Forward-` reach the destination without the prefix: `Upstash-Forward-Authorization: Bearer …` arrives as `Authorization: Bearer …`. `Content-Type` and `Upstash-Workflow-*` headers are passed on as they are; nothing else is.

Headers that start with `Upstash-Callback-` and `Upstash-Failure-Callback-` set up the callbacks the same way, as if they were published: `Upstash-Callback-Retries`, `Upstash-Callback-Forward-X-Trace` and so on.

Each delivery carries `Upstash-Signature`, a JWT signed with the current signing key that `Receiver.verify` in `@upstash/qstash` checks, plus `Upstash-Message-Id` and `Upstash-Retried`.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: A URL, written out as it is, slashes and query string included: `/v2/publish/https://example.com/hooks/order?id=7`. Or the name of a URL group, to publish to each of its endpoints.

parameters.name: Upstash-Method
parameters.description: The method of the delivery. Default `POST`.

parameters.name: Upstash-Delay
parameters.description: Wait this long before the first attempt: `10s`, `5m`, `1h30m`, `2d`.

parameters.name: Upstash-Not-Before
parameters.description: Do not deliver before this time, in Unix seconds.

parameters.name: Upstash-Retries
parameters.description: Attempts after the first one fails. Default 3.

parameters.name: Upstash-Retry-Delay
parameters.description: Milliseconds to wait before each retry, as arithmetic on `retried`: `pow(2, retried) * 1000`. Functions: pow, sqrt, abs, exp, floor, ceil, round, min, max. Default: e^(2.5 × retried) seconds, at most a day.

parameters.name: Upstash-Timeout
parameters.description: How long one attempt may take: `30s`, `5m`. Default 5 minutes.

parameters.name: Upstash-Callback
parameters.description: A URL to publish the outcome of each attempt to.

parameters.name: Upstash-Failure-Callback
parameters.description: A URL to publish to once all attempts have failed, with the id of the DLQ entry.

parameters.name: Upstash-Deduplication-Id
parameters.description: Publishing again with the same id, to the same destination, within the deduplication window (10 minutes by default) returns the first message instead of creating one.

parameters.name: Upstash-Content-Based-Deduplication
parameters.description: `true` deduplicates by destination, method, forwarded headers and body.

parameters.name: Upstash-Flow-Control-Key
parameters.description: Messages sharing a key share its limits.

parameters.name: Upstash-Flow-Control-Value
parameters.description: The limits for the key: `parallelism=2, rate=10, period=1m`.

parameters.name: Upstash-Label
parameters.description: Labels to find the message by in logs and the DLQ, separated by commas.
